load_llff_dataset: load LLFF dataset images, poses, and bounds from a directory for neural radiance field training
generate_spiral_render_path: generate spiral camera path poses for novel view synthesis using render_path_spiral function
generate_lightfield_render_path: generate lightfield grid camera path poses for novel view synthesis using render_path_lightfield function
recenter_and_spherify_poses: recenter camera poses to scene center and optionally spherify them for 360 degree datasets
compute_average_pose: compute the average camera-to-world pose from a set of poses using poses_avg function
